body:
Arjas Steel acquisition → integrated ore-to-steel; FY26 FCF ₹988 cr cut debt 1,890→904; quarterly PAT ~140→~240 cr for 3 qtrs; bonus not dilution. Commodity cyclical.
Kill criteria: Qtr PAT <₹180 cr for 2 qtrs; net debt rising for new acquisition; FII <1.5%; adverse Karnataka mining levy
Caveat: sourced from public screens — no proprietary edge (lesson L1). Pledges not confirmed from NSE SAST.
